evals.prompt: 用 Touying 0.8.0 给我搭一个 .typ 演示文稿，套 metropolis 主题，包含标题页、几个分节和正文页。
evals.expected_output: Authors a Touying 0.8.0 .typ deck importing @preview/touying:0.8.0 and themes.metropolis, applies it via #show, and uses headings/slides without touching non-Typst formats.
assertions: The response imports @preview/touying:0.8.0 (targeting Typst 0.15.0+) and a Touying theme via #show.
It uses headings or #slide for slide structure and checks workspace layout first if existing files exist.
It does not produce HTML, PPT, reveal.js, or Marp output.

evals.prompt: 我的 Touying 幻灯片想加逐步出现的动画，还想把被遮盖的文本变半透明、在分式公式里逐步显示，应该怎么写？
evals.expected_output: Uses Touying 0.8.0 animation syntax (#pause, #uncover/#only/#animate), alpha-changing-cover or color-changing-cover instead of deprecated semi-transparent-cover, native math animation inside frac instead of touying-equation, and warns against #pause inside context.
assertions: The response uses Touying 0.8.0 animations (#pause, #uncover, #only, or #animate) and warns against placing #pause inside context.
It recommends utils.alpha-changing-cover or utils.color-changing-cover instead of deprecated semi-transparent-cover.
It uses native math animation inside $ frac(...) $ instead of deprecated touying-equation.

evals.prompt: Touying 里怎么改 slide-level、配置页面尺寸、页脚和溢出检测？我想把配置集中放到 globals.typ 里。
evals.expected_output: Uses globals.typ + main.typ + section files layout, config-common(slide-level: ..., breakable: ..., detect-overflow: ...), config-page, and config-info instead of raw set page.
assertions: The response uses config-common and config-page instead of raw #set page.
It centralizes shared imports and helpers in globals.typ so main.typ and sections avoid circular imports.
It configures slide-level and overflow options accurately for Touying 0.8.0.

evals.prompt: 我有一个 0.6.1 的 Touying 工程，升级到 0.8.0 时 magic.bibliography()、show-only-notes 和 touying-recall 报错了，怎么迁移？
evals.expected_output: Follows references/migration-0.8.md: bumps Typst to 0.15.0+, switches to boolean show-bibliography-as-footnote: true with a real #bibliography, uses config-common(notes-fn: ..) with touying-notes, and updates touying-recall(subslides: ..).
assertions: The response migrates show-bibliography-as-footnote to boolean true paired with a real #bibliography(...) and removes magic.bibliography().
It replaces the removed config-methods(show-only-notes: ..) renderer with config-common(notes-fn: ..) built on touying-notes.
It updates touying-recall to plural subslides: with swapped auto/none semantics and checks --warnings promote.

evals.prompt: 帮我做一套网页幻灯片，用 reveal.js 或 Marp，或者导出成 PPT 发给同事。
evals.expected_output: Negative trigger. HTML, reveal.js, Marp, and PPT decks are explicitly excluded from touying.
assertions: The skill description and Trigger section explicitly exclude HTML, reveal.js, PPT, and Marp.
The response declines Typst/Touying authoring and points the user to a web/HTML, Marp, or PPT tool instead.

evals.prompt: 帮我用 XeLaTeX 写一个中文硕士学位论文答辩 Beamer 幻灯片，匹配学校论文答辩模板。
evals.expected_output: Near-neighbor negative trigger. XeLaTeX Chinese thesis defense Beamer decks belong to academic-defense-beamer, not touying.
assertions: The skill description and exclusions explicitly defer XeLaTeX thesis defense decks to academic-defense-beamer.
The response does not force a XeLaTeX thesis defense request into Typst/Touying.

evals.prompt: 在 Touying 0.8.0 幻灯片里，怎么用 Waypoints（比如层级标签、from-wp、until-wp、not-wp）和 #animate / swap 组合先隐藏再替换并高亮变红？
evals.expected_output: Follows references/animations-waypoints.md: declares #waypoint(<part:intro>) / <part:end>, uses from-wp/until-wp/not-wp/get-last instead of negative integer indices, and configures #animate or #animate-hidden with swap(..., stretch: true) and styling priority rules.
assertions: The response uses #waypoint with hierarchical labels or markers (from-wp, until-wp, get-last, or not-wp) and never relies on negative integers on flow-parsed animation functions.
It uses #animate or #animate-hidden with placement ("cover"/"remove"/swap) and styling priority composition.
It mentions stretch: true measurement trade-offs and notes that #pause after #uncover/#only does not snap past reserved subslides in 0.8.0.

evals.prompt: 怎么在 Touying 0.8.0 的分式、矩阵和上下标原生公式里直接做渐进动画，同时用 #touying-render 展示中间阶段并用 #measure 计算动画块最大高度？
evals.expected_output: Follows references/animations-waypoints.md: puts #pause/#uncover directly inside native $ frac(...) $, $ mat(...) $, and $ attach(...) $ instead of deprecated touying-equation, uses #touying-render(body, subslides: ..., start: ..., repeat-last: ...), and uses #measure(body, subslide: none) inside context.
assertions: The response writes native Typst math animations inside frac, mat, or attach instead of deprecated touying-equation.
It uses #touying-render with subslides: / start: / repeat-last: to render intermediate stages of a content value.
It calls Touying's #measure(..., subslide: none) inside context to measure animated content dimensions.

evals.prompt: 我想让同一份 Touying 0.8.0 源文件支持 --input export-mode=article、handout 和 presentation 三种导出，并在文章模式里用 #article-text 替换讲稿段落、让图片和 CeTZ 图形靠右环绕、保留带表头的表格不被扁平化。
evals.expected_output: Follows references/output-modes-article.md: documents export-mode ("slides", "presentation", "handout", "article") and --input export-mode=, mode markers (#article-text, #article-only, #slides-only, <touying:...>), themes.article, and verified config-article(wrap: ..., linearize: ..., available-fields: ...) keys with table.header and graphic-marker-of.
assertions: The response uses --input export-mode= (presentation, handout, article) alongside #article-text, #article-only, or #slides-only mode markers.
It uses exact 0.8.0 config-article(wrap: ..., linearize: ..., available-fields: ...) syntax with wrap.overrides and graphic-marker-of rather than nonexistent wrap-images or wrap-width keys.
It explains that table.header/grid.header (or #article-keep-layout) prevents automatic linearization of structured tables in article mode.
